_about: External skills used by motion-video-router. Each points at a fork under miguelfdsc and the commit that was last tested. Sessions clone the fork and check out `commit`. To upgrade: Sync fork on GitHub, test, then bump `commit` and `tested`.

skills.name: video-director
skills.use: Plan, direct, build and verify a code-rendered film

skills.name: huashu-motion
skills.use: Launch/promo film with its own score; original music to sync marks

skills.name: explainroo
skills.use: Explainer with local voice-over (no API key)

skills.name: motion-design
skills.use: Motion principles, easing, timing, Lottie output

skills.name: rossark-motion-skill
skills.use: Organic secondary motion: characters, blinks, breathing, fabric, fire, water, machines

skills.name: reanimate
skills.use: Clone/match an animation from a URL, mp4, gif or Lottie frame by frame

skills.name: design-dna
skills.use: Extract a brand/design system from references

skills.name: threejs-*
skills.use: 3D in the browser (13 skills: fundamentals, materials, lighting, animation, postprocessing...)

skills.name: earshot
skills.use: Make SFX/foley/UI sounds offline; listen to audio with the mirrored models (see MODELS.md)

skills.name: real-sound
skills.use: Soundtrack from real licensed recordings: mix, QA, credits (sourcing needs files supplied by the user in cloud sessions)
